amphipolis.model

Class Player

  • java.lang.Object
    • amphipolis.model.Player

  • public class Player
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a single player in the game. Maintains the state of the user, including their personal inventory of collected tiles, their assigned character cards, and their current score. Invariant: The player's score must always be non-negative. Invariant: The player owns exactly 5 Character cards of a specific color. Invariant: The collected tiles list is never null (though it may be empty).

    • Method Detail

      • getLastVisitedZone

        public Zone getLastVisitedZone()
        Gets the zone the player visited during the standard action of the current turn. This is used to enforce restrictions for characters like the Archaeologist.
        Returns:
        The zone visited this turn, or null if reset or not yet selected.

      • setLastVisitedZone

        public void setLastVisitedZone(Zone lastVisitedZone)
        Sets the zone the player visited during the current turn. This should be reset to null at the start of every new turn.
        Parameters:
        lastVisitedZone - The zone to mark as visited.

      • getCoderReservedZone

        public Zone getCoderReservedZone()
        Gets the zone reserved by the Coder character in the previous turn. If this returns a non-null value, the player is entitled to extra tiles from this zone at the start of their turn.
        Returns:
        The reserved zone, or null if no reservation exists.

      • setCoderReservedZone

        public void setCoderReservedZone(Zone coderReservedZone)
        Sets the zone reserved by the Coder character for the next turn. Post-condition: This selection persists across the round until the player's next turn.
        Parameters:
        coderReservedZone - The zone to reserve.

      • computePoints

        public int computePoints()
        Calculates the total score based on collected tiles (Mosaics, Skeletons, Amphoras). Statues are calculated by the Controller and added separately. Post-condition: Updates and returns the score variable.
        Returns:
        The calculated score.
